_readme: Every value below is a working sample so you can walk the hunt today. Replace them with your real ones. Run `node build.mjs` after any change — it prints every answer back at you and checks the three digits add up.

gate.prompt: Before anything else. What was the name of the pub?

briefing: This will take you out of the house, so put shoes on.
About ninety minutes. No timer, no rush, nothing expires.
Charge your phone. Everything lives on it.
Take a pen and something to write on.
Say yes when Safari asks for your location.
Message me any time, about anything. There is no penalty and I am not scoring you.

stages.label: One
stages.title: The shelf
clue: Four of us have turned our backs on you.
Dark is nothing. Light is one.
Read those four left to right, then count that many in from the left of the shelf.

stages.label: Two
stages.title: The liar
clue: There are more of us in that room than you think, and every one of us is a square.
But one of us is lying.
Count us. Then find the liar.
stages.after: Now look at what the liar is wearing.

stages.label: Three
stages.title: The lie detector
clue: Every barcode carries a lie detector in its last digit. Someone has been at this one with a marker.
stages.note: From the left: multiply the 1st, 3rd, 5th… digits by 1, and the 2nd, 4th, 6th… by 3. Add it all up. The check digit is whatever gets you to the next multiple of ten.

stages.label: Four
stages.title: Page, line, word
clue: The book knows which book.
stages.after: Message him now. He may take a few minutes to reply — don't stand around waiting. Keep going.

stages.label: Five
stages.title: Three words
clue: Three words will take you there, and you already have all three.
You just don't know what order they go in.
stages.note: Smallest to largest. Then type them into what3words.

stages.label: Six
stages.title: The reply
clue: By now he should have written back.
Do what he says.

stages.label: Seven
stages.title: Warmer
clue: There is no address for this one.
Walk. I'll tell you if you're getting closer.
stages.reveal: Stop. It's within arm's reach of you — low down, tucked out of sight.

stages.label: Eight
stages.title: Nine pieces
clue: Sort them. Smallest to largest, left to right, top to bottom.
Then turn the whole thing over.

stages.label: Nine
stages.title: The way back
clue: Go home.
There is something on the kitchen table that wasn't there when you left.

stages.label: Ten
stages.title: Us
clue: Put us back together.
The small numbers in the corners are so you don't lose your place when you turn it over.

finale.heading: That's all three.
finale.body: Add them up. If they don't make the number below, one of them slipped somewhere and you should message me.
finale.where: It's the padlock on the thing in the hallway. You'll know it when you see it.
